title: Ether 1D Continuous Variables Dictionary & Ontological Metadata

worldPopulation.name: World Population
worldPopulation.source: McEvedy & Jones (1978), UN World Population Prospects (2024 Revision), HYDE 3.2

grossWorldProduct.name: Gross World Product (GWP)
grossWorldProduct.source: Maddison Project Database (2020), Bolt & van Zanden (2020), IPCC AR6 SSP2 (MESSAGEix)

primaryEnergy.name: Primary Energy Consumption
primaryEnergy.description: Total global energy harvest from muscle, wood, coal, oil, gas, nuclear, and renewables.
primaryEnergy.source: Vaclav Smil (2017) 'Energy and Civilization', IEA (2024), IPCC AR6 SSP2 (IMAGE)

urbanizationRate.name: Urbanization Rate
urbanizationRate.unit: Percentage (%) of population in settlements > 5,000 inhabitants
urbanizationRate.source: Paul Bairoch (1988), Tertius Chandler (1987), UN World Urbanization Prospects (2024)

co2Concentration.name: Atmospheric CO2 Concentration
co2Concentration.source: EPICA Dome C, Law Dome Ice Core, NOAA ESRL Mauna Loa, IPCC AR6 SSP2-4.5 (MAGICC7)

literacyRate.name: Literacy Rate
literacyRate.unit: Percentage (%) of adult population able to read and write
literacyRate.source: Buringh & van Zanden (2009), UNESCO Institute for Statistics

currencyDebasement.name: Roman & Classical Silver Coinage Content
currencyDebasement.unit: Percentage (%) of pure silver in Denarius / standard coin
currencyDebasement.description: Purity of state coinage (indicator of fiscal crisis).
currencyDebasement.source: Butcher & Ponting (2014) 'The Metallurgy of Roman Silver Coinage'

eliteOverproductionIndex.name: Elite Overproduction Index
eliteOverproductionIndex.unit: Normalized Index (1.0 = Baseline Balance, > 2.0 = High Crisis Risk)
eliteOverproductionIndex.description: Ratio of elite aspirants competing for fixed leadership positions.
eliteOverproductionIndex.source: Peter Turchin (2016) 'Ages of Discord', Seshat Databank

realUnskilledWage.name: Real Unskilled Worker Purchasing Power
realUnskilledWage.description: Purchasing power of unskilled urban/rural laborers relative to subsistence needs.
realUnskilledWage.source: Robert C. Allen (2001) 'The Great Divergence in European Wages and Prices'

politicalStressIndex.name: Political Stress Index (PSI)
politicalStressIndex.unit: Composite Index (0 = Stable, 100 = Structural State Collapse)
politicalStressIndex.description: Structural-demographic pressure score combining mass immiseration, elite competition, and fiscal distress.

asabiyyahSocialCohesion.name: Asabiyyah / Collective Solidarity Score
asabiyyahSocialCohesion.unit: Normalized Score (0.0 = Atomized/Decadent, 1.0 = Maximum Frontier Solidarism)
asabiyyahSocialCohesion.description: Ibn Khaldunian social cohesion metric measuring group capacity for collective action.

sociopoliticalInstability.name: Sociopolitical Violence & Instability Index
sociopoliticalInstability.description: Frequency and severity of revolts, civil wars, assassinations, and riots.
sociopoliticalInstability.source: Seshat Databank, Correlates of War (COW) Project

giniInequality.name: Wealth & Land Gini Coefficient
giniInequality.unit: Gini Index (0.0 = Perfect Equality, 1.0 = Total Monopolization)
giniInequality.description: Inequality of wealth and land ownership.
giniInequality.source: Walter Scheidel (2017) 'The Great Leveler', Branko Milanovic (2016)

sovereignDebtBurden.name: Sovereign Debt Burden
sovereignDebtBurden.unit: Percentage (%) of Gross Product / State Revenue
sovereignDebtBurden.description: Government debt relative to economic capacity.
sovereignDebtBurden.source: Reinhart & Rogoff (2009) 'This Time Is Different', IMF Global Debt Database

globalTradeVolume.name: Global Trade Volume Index
globalTradeVolume.description: Volume of international and inter-regional commodity trade.

temperatureAnomaly.name: Global Surface Temperature Anomaly
temperatureAnomaly.unit: Degrees Celsius (Ã‚Â°C) relative to 1850-1900 pre-industrial baseline
temperatureAnomaly.source: PAGES 2k Consortium, HadCRUT5, IPCC AR6 SSP2-4.5 (2021)

soilErosionRate.name: Topsoil Erosion & Salinization Loss
soilErosionRate.unit: Percentage (%) of topsoil loss relative to original Holocene baseline
soilErosionRate.source: Montgomery (2007) 'Dirt: The Erosion of Civilizations', FAO

agriculturalEroei.name: Agricultural EROEI (Energy Return on Investment)
agriculturalEroei.description: Net energy yield of food production systems.
agriculturalEroei.source: Vaclav Smil (2008) 'Energy in Nature and Society', Giampietro et al. (2013)

deforestationRate.name: Global Forest Cover Remaining
deforestationRate.unit: Percentage (%) of original post-glacial forest area remaining
deforestationRate.source: HYDE 3.2, FAO Global Forest Resources Assessment

informationSpeed.name: Information Travel Speed
informationSpeed.description: Speed of news, orders, and knowledge transmission across distance.
informationSpeed.source: Scheidel (2014) 'ORBIS: The Stanford Geospatial Network Model of the Roman World'

megafaunaIndex.name: Megafauna Biomass & Survival Index
megafaunaIndex.unit: Percentage (%) of Late Pleistocene Baseline Biomass
megafaunaIndex.description: Global terrestrial megafauna (>44 kg) biomass retention.
megafaunaIndex.source: Sandom et al. (2014), Barnosky (2004), WWF Living Planet Report (2024)

milankovitchInsolation.name: Milankovitch Summer Insolation 65Ã‚Â°N
milankovitchInsolation.description: Mid-June solar radiative forcing at 65Ã‚Â°N driving Quaternary glacial-interglacial cycles.

zeroContainmentScore.name: Biogeographical Isolation & Containment Score
zeroContainmentScore.unit: Normalized Score (1.0 = Pristine Continental Isolation, 0.0 = Total Homogenization)
zeroContainmentScore.description: Quantifies the degree of biogeographical barrier integrity against invasive pathogens and alien species.
zeroContainmentScore.source: Crosby (1972) 'The Columbian Exchange', Diamond (1997), Seebens et al. (2017)

lifeExpectancyAtBirth.name: Global Life Expectancy at Birth
lifeExpectancyAtBirth.description: Mean cohort life expectancy at birth across human populations.

metalSmeltingPerCapita.name: Per Capita Metal Smelting Output
metalSmeltingPerCapita.description: Annual per capita output of smelted structural metals (copper, bronze, pig iron, raw steel).
metalSmeltingPerCapita.source: World Steel Association, Malandra (1990), USGS Historical Mineral Statistics

fossilSharePrimaryEnergy.name: Fossil Fuel Share in Primary Energy
fossilSharePrimaryEnergy.unit: Percentage (%) of Total Primary Energy Harvest
fossilSharePrimaryEnergy.description: Proportion of global energy consumption derived from coal, crude oil, and fossil gas.
fossilSharePrimaryEnergy.source: Vaclav Smil (2017) 'Energy and Civilization', Our World in Data (2024)

shippingFreightCostIndex.name: Real Maritime Shipping Freight Cost Index
shippingFreightCostIndex.description: Real cost of trans-oceanic dry bulk commodity transport adjusted for inflation.
